The base class of the backends, the window bridge contract and the UI bridges that hold, route and draw the UIs of a window.
Learn: [Choosing a backend](/use/learn/running/backends/), [Embedding JOID](/use/learn/running/embedding/), [Writing a backend](/build/writing-a-backend/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Backend`](/reference/backends/backend/) | class | The base class of every backend, which connects JOID to a window, a graphics API and an audio device in one `register()` call. |
| [`IUIBridge`](/reference/backends/iuibridge/) | interface | The contract of a UI bridge, the place where JOID opens, holds and closes the UIs of one surface. |
| [`IWindowBridge`](/reference/backends/iwindowbridge/) | interface | The bridge that reads the drawable size, the mouse, the held keys and the clipboard of the window, in screen pixels. |
| [`StackUIBridge`](/reference/backends/stackuibridge/) | class | A UI bridge in which opening a screen closes the open screens and popups, while overlays and popups stack above them. |
| [`UIBridge`](/reference/backends/uibridge/) | class | The base class of every UI bridge, which dispatches the input to its UIs, updates them and draws them by layer. |
| [`UIBridgeRegistry`](/reference/backends/uibridgeregistry/) | class | The registry of UI bridges, which runs the frame of each one and routes the input between them. |
| [`WindowUIBridge`](/reference/backends/windowuibridge/) | class | The default UI bridge, which clears the window to a color every frame and draws text tooltips. |
